prose: Zenzap is a private work messenger with built-in AI agents, aimed at companies whose staff coordinate over WhatsApp, Telegram or iMessage. It promises company context for the AI while keeping to IT and security rules.
It has raised $44 million from investors including Bessemer and Lightspeed. Founder Guy Weiss is raising for the first time after earlier bootstrapping a marketing platform.
highlights: Zenzap pitches a private work messenger with AI agents.
Raised $44 million led by Bessemer and Lightspeed.
